pull.title: Use Codex's OAuth client for MCP when the workspace doesn't advertise CIMD
pull.body:
## Summary
The Codex desktop app shows `ug`'s MCP servers as **"Auth unsupported"**. Codex uses that label for every stdio server, and `ug` writes the stdio `ug mcp-proxy` entry. Since #1257, `ug` writes the native URL + OAuth entry only when the workspace advertises `client_id_metadata_document_supported`. Workspaces such as `eng-ml-inference.staging` and `dbc-a5d4177a-49dc` don't advertise it, even though they accept Codex's published client (`https://chatgpt.com/oauth/codex/client.json`).

With this change, Codex skips the advertisement check. It still needs the existing `oauth_client_available` token-endpoint probe to pass, and the service still has to be connection-backed. Claude and Cursor are unchanged, and so are PAT and unknown-client fallbacks, which still use the proxy.

## Testing
- Manual check on macOS against `eng-ml-inference.staging`: I hand-wrote a URL + OAuth entry with the Codex client and ran `codex mcp login`. The browser sign-in completed.
- `uv run pytest tests/test_mcp.py tests/test_agent_codex.py tests/test_mcp_oauth.py` passes. Cursor keeps its test that requires the advertisement, and Codex gets a new test that skips it.
- `just lint` passes. In the full suite, 12 tests fail. 11 of them also fail on unchanged main (`test_agents_init` required-update, `test_e2e_user_agent`, `test_smart_router`). The 12th, one run of `test_launcher_flags_control_routing_hook`, passed when I reran it on main.

This pull request and its description were written by Isaac.

files.patch:
+    # Codex's client signs in on workspaces that don't advertise CIMD support yet.
+    if client == "codex" or workspace_supports_cimd(workspace):

+    def test_cursor_native_cimd_requires_workspace_support(self, monkeypatch):
+        assert mcp._oauth_http_client("cursor", WS, use_pat=False) is None
+
+    def test_codex_native_cimd_skips_workspace_support(self, monkeypatch):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(mcp, "workspace_supports_cimd", lambda ws: False)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(mcp, "oauth_client_available", lambda ws, client_id: True)
+        assert mcp._oauth_http_client("codex", WS, use_pat=False) == mcp.CODEX_CIMD_CLIENT_ID

commit.message:
Use Codex's OAuth client for MCP when the workspace doesn't advertise CIMD

Codex desktop labels stdio MCP servers "Auth unsupported". Workspaces that
recognize Codex's published client but don't advertise CIMD metadata fell
back to the proxy; use the URL + OAuth entry for Codex whenever the client
probe passes.

Co-authored-by: Isaac <no-reply@databricks.com>
